title: CIBC Smart Account — Fees and Details
section: Explore CIBC Smart Account fees; Record keeping fees
text: For Tier 1, the monthly fee for up to three Smart Accounts is $16.95. A rebate is available when one Smart Account holds at least $4,000 at the end of every day of the month. Tier 2 and Tier 3 list a $0 monthly fee. The table lists unlimited transactions and Interac e-Transfer transactions for all three tiers. Paperless statements are free. Paper statements cost $2.25 monthly, $0.75 quarterly, or $2.75 monthly with cheque images.

title: How to Open Joint Accounts
section: FAQs: identification; opening an account; removing a name; closing a joint account
text: A personal account application requires name, date of birth, occupation if applicable, and address if applicable, plus up to two valid original identification documents that are not substantially defaced. The FAQ lists banking centres, online banking, the mobile app, and telephone banking as single-holder opening channels, with product-specific exceptions. Joint accounts can be opened at a banking centre or through telephone banking. Removing your own name from a shared account is not offered; the FAQ instead describes closing it at a banking centre. Before joint-account closure, cancel automatic payments and settle remaining debts; the other holder need not attend.

title: Protect yourself from bank impersonator scams
section: What you need to know; Warning signs; Stay safe with our tips
text: Impersonators may seek verification codes to gain account access or authorize transactions. A suspicious caller claiming to represent CIBC should be disconnected; the customer should contact the bank through a trusted channel. Do not disclose credentials or sensitive banking information to unfamiliar people. Caller ID can be spoofed. Verify contact details independently using the bank’s official website, a statement, or the back of a card. A verification code can legitimately be entered by the customer to confirm their own transaction; that does not justify sharing it with a caller.
